title: Do Large Language Models Truly Understand Cross-cultural Differences?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured LLMs' reasoning on culturally grounded concepts within the 'Spirituality and Religion' dimension, which includes sacred/profane distinctions, taboos, and spiritually grounded norms.
findings: LLMs exhibit low baseline performance in understanding concepts related to spirituality and religion, but show significant improvement with conceptual knowledge injection. GPT-40, for instance, demonstrated a steep performance increase in this dimension, indicating an ability to navigate symbolic and ritualistic content when provided with explicit guidance. This suggests models possess some relevant knowledge but fail to apply it in realistic scenarios without contextual scaffolding.
